title: やゆよ
jp: や行 ・ gojuon row 8 (short row) ・ at home
blurb: Row 8 of the gojuon — や ゆ よ — a SHORT row (three kana), taught at home: a red roof and the kettle's steam, little fingers on a clean floor, tea in a cup, a quiet night. Say the thing, then use it. The home variation of three や-row songs (home · nature · a fun day out).
concept: や行 is a short row — only three kana (や ゆ よ; the い/え slots are borrowed from あ行). So this song is 3 groups of 3 words (9 targets) instead of the usual 15, and the refrain is just や ゆ よ. Naturally a shorter song — the vertical cut is the sweet spot.

Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small action — やさい を たべる, ゆのみ の おちゃ — recombining earlier rows (たべる, おちゃ, いえ return; F-13). The row closes every verse for the sung-together refrain (F-07); the longer cut adds a bridge + sentences-only review, not a loop (F-12).
This is the home variation. Pairs with the Female (city pop) voice.
